summary: Tested the Commandes + Préparation merge on backend and frontend. Backend (new tests/test_commandes_merge.py): 25/26 pass. Deposit guard works on /status and /status-v3: confirming an en_attente_acompte order before the deposit returns 400 'Acompte non reçu…', and mark-deposit-paid then moves it to confirmee. sales, stock_keeper and CM get 403 on confirm (both endpoints). Manager and admin can confirm. stock_keeper and sales can set en_preparation and prete (both endpoints) but cannot cancel; CM cannot prepare. Assign day: the session is created and then reused for the same rider and date, add-order sets the order to assignee with rider and session, and the rider gets a 'Nouvelle course attribuée' user_notification. The dashboard action-items links are correct. The 1 failure is a guard bypass: sales calls PATCH /api/orders/{id} {status:'confirmee'} -> 200 and the order is confirmed. Frontend (Playwright, admin/manager/stock): all 10 tabs show the correct counts, checked against the DB (638/23/77/28/40/42/38/358/30/2), and ?tab= stays after reload. New labels are shown. Row Confirmer gives the toast and the order moves to À préparer. Bulk confirm of 2 orders gives the toast '2 commandes confirmées'. The deposit order shows order-deposit badge and no Confirmer. Préparer sets en_preparation, opens PrepRunner (wrong scan toast, scan and manual override with reason), then Prête, the fiche colis PDF preview opens and you return to the list. Kanban: 11 columns, cards with checkbox and Confirmer/Préparer/acompte badge. Assigning a Prête selection plus 1 non-prête shows the toast 'non prête(s) ignorée(s)', assign-day-modal sends only the 3 Prête orders, they move to Affectée, and the rider is notified. Bulk print gives one PDF 'fiches-colis-3.pdf' with 3 pages; per-row slip works. Order detail: Prochaine étape has Confirmer, then Préparer, which opens the scan screen inside the detail page; Retour brings back 'Reprendre'. /console/preparation redirects to ?tab=confirmee. There is no Préparation item for admin or manager. stock_keeper sees Commandes plus 'À préparer', has no Confirmer/Affecter (only Imprimer), and can Préparer up to Prête. The dashboard cards À confirmer / À affecter link correctly.

critical.issue: The generic order update accepts any body keys, including 'status', with no order_transition_guard. sales (full /api/orders allow-list) can PATCH {status:'confirmee'} -> 200 and the order is confirmed. This bypasses the rule that only the gérante/owner confirms. It also bypasses the deposit guard for any role that can call it. Fix: pop status/timeline/rider_id/session_id/deposit_* from the body, or run order_transition_guard when 'status' is present.

minor.issue: It does not check that the order is 'prete'; only the frontend filters. It also does not set order.delivery_date to the session date (assigning to 2030-01-20 left delivery_date undefined) and does not add an 'assignee' timeline entry.

community_manager is only blocked by the role_access read-only allow-list. order_transition_guard's limited-role rule only lists stock_keeper and sales. That works today, but 'community_manager' should be added there too, as defence in depth.

ui_bugs.issue: The catch shows a generic toast 'Erreur' and drops the backend detail. Clicking the od-status-confirmee chip on an en_attente_acompte order shows 'Erreur' instead of 'Acompte non reçu…'. 403 role messages are hidden the same way.
On /console/commandes?tab=confirmee, both 'Commandes' and 'À préparer' are highlighted as active, because NavLink matching ignores the query string.
The invoice-view/pdf/wa icons are shown to stock_keeper, but POST /api/invoices/from-order returns 403, so clicking gives 'Erreur facture'. Hide them for limited roles.
There are no columns for 'retournee' (13 orders) or 'recuperee', so these orders are invisible in Kanban 'Toutes'. The Annulées/Reportées tab counts 30, but the Kanban columns show 17.
Any status-v3 error (e.g. 400 'Scan incomplet') is caught and silently retried via /status, which skips the scan check.

issues: assign-day-date and the filters date use the browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar.
The table needs horizontal scrolling: the Statut/Action (Confirmer/Préparer) columns are off-screen, and there is no card layout on mobile.
The active tab chip (e.g. Prêtes) is not scrolled into view.
The table does not fill the card width; there is a large empty area on the right at 1920px.

The manual still has the addendum 'Préparation : Cartes, Tableau, Kanban', which says 'Dans Préparation…' and describes drag-and-drop Kanban (backend/manual_addenda.py add-prep-views, plus the stored manual_modules doc). The page is removed and the new Kanban has no drag-and-drop.
'/console/preparation' is still listed in frontend/src/lib/rbac.js. It is harmless (the route redirects) but it is dead config.

action_items: HIGH: Block 'status' (and the rider/session/deposit fields) in PATCH /api/orders/{id}, or route it through order_transition_guard. sales can currently confirm orders this way.
OrderDetail.changeStatus: show e.response.data.detail in the error toast.
add-order: set delivery_date = session.date, push an 'assignee' timeline entry, and optionally reject non-prete orders server-side.
Add retournee/recuperee to the Kanban (or include them in an Annulées/Reportées column).
Hide the invoice buttons for stock_keeper, and fix the double-active sidebar items.
Update the manual addendum add-prep-views (and the stored manual_modules) to describe the merged Commandes flow.
Use the shadcn Calendar in AssignDayModal; add a responsive card layout for mobile Commandes.
critical_code_review_comments: Orders.jsx: OrderDrawer (about 80 lines) and the 'selected' state are dead code; setSelected is never called with an order.
PrepRunner's .catch fallback to /status hides real validation errors.
AssignDayModal: the sequential add-order loop has no partial-failure reporting. If order 2 of 5 fails, the first ones are assigned but the toast only shows the error.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; minor UI issues above)

seed_data_creation: 8 TEST_UI orders and many TEST_ orders were created with fake product_ids (no stock impact) and all deleted. The delivery sessions for 2030-01-15 and 2030-01-20, the user_notifications, and today's attendance for stock/manager/agent1/cm were removed. Order count is back to 630.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_commandes_merge.py -n 0. It punches arrival for manager, stock, agent1 and cm, then cleans up. The UI seed is python tests/ui_seed_commandes.py seed|clean. Limited roles must have an arrival punch: python tests/ui_punch.py email pw pin. Staff login inputs: input:visible nth(0)/nth(1) + button 'Se connecter'. The PDF preview modal uses pdf-preview-modal/pdf-preview-title/pdf-preview-pages (one canvas per page).
rca of the issue: Confirmation bypass: routers/orders.py update_order does $set of the raw body, so 'status' passes straight through. role_access gives sales full /api/orders, so the PATCH is allowed. The guard is only called in update_order_status and update_order_status_v3.
